start: Member page of a member whose plan was sold with a start date in the future; owner signed in, online

steps.action: On that plan's row tap "Change start date"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Change start date"
The plan name and "now <start> → <last day>."
Box "New start date" holding the present start
Hint "Pick the day the member will start."
Button "Save start date" greyed out
must_not: An error shown before anything was changed
The button live while the date is unchanged

steps.action: Pick a new start 5 days later
user_sees: Hint "The member keeps every day they paid for. The plan will end on <last day + 5>."
"Save start date" becomes live
must_not: A last day that makes the plan shorter or longer than before

user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"
The sheet closes
Message "Start date changed to <new day>."
must_not: The plan's price, dues or receipts changed
The joining date of the member changed

steps.action: Look at the plan row and its history
user_sees: The new start and last day
History line "Start date changed: <old> → <new>"

start: Member page of a member with a running gym plan and a personal-training pack that starts next week

steps.action: On the PT pack row tap "Change start date"
user_sees: Sheet "Change start date" for the PT pack
must_not: The button missing on a PT pack that has not started

steps.action: Pick a start that falls inside the running gym plan
user_sees: The hint with the new last day; no overlap message, because a PT pack runs beside a gym plan
must_not: "These dates overlap their <plan> plan" for a PT pack

user_sees: "Start date changed to <day>."

start: Member page; the member has a plan running till the 30th and a renewal sold to start on the 1st of next month

steps.action: Tap "Change start date" on the renewal and pick the 25th (inside the running plan)
user_sees: Under the box: "These dates overlap their <plan name> plan (<start> → <last day>). Pick a start after it ends."
"Save start date" greyed out
must_not: Two gym plans saved over the same days

steps.action: Pick a day more than 31 days before today
user_sees: "The start can't be more than 31 days ago."
"Pick a start date." and the button stays greyed out
must_not: A save with an empty or half-typed date

steps.action: Look at a plan that has already started, and at a cancelled plan
user_sees: No "Change start date" button on either row
must_not: The button offered on a plan whose days are already being used

steps.action: Turn the internet off and look at the future plan's row
user_sees: "Change start date" cannot be pressed without internet
must_not: A change that looks saved but never reaches the server

start: Member page; a plan starting in 10 days whose start was already changed once

steps.action: Open "Change start date" again and pick another day
user_sees: The sheet shows the present (already moved) dates under "now"
must_not: The dates from before the first change

user_sees: A second history line "Start date changed: <old> → <new>"; the first line is still there

steps.action: Change the start once more, this time to today
user_sees: "Start date changed to <today>."
The plan now counts as started
must_not: The member shown as not active today

steps.action: Look for "Change start date" on the same row to undo it
user_sees: The button is gone: a plan that has started can only be moved with "Freeze / extra days"
must_not: The owner believing the move to today can be taken back the same way; nothing on the sheet says it cannot
